network.bridge_create: nmcli connection add type bridge ifname {interface} con-name fnas-{interface} connection.autoconnect-priority 100
network.bridge_add_port: nmcli connection add type bridge-slave ifname {interface} master {bridge_name}
set_static_ip: nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname {interface} con-name fnas-{interface} connection.autoconnect-priority 100 ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses {ip}/{cidr} ipv4.gateway {gateway} ipv4.dns {dns}
network.connection_ensure: nmcli -g connection.id connection show fnas-{interface} >/dev/null 2>&1 || nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname {interface} con-name fnas-{interface} connection.autoconnect-priority 100
network.connection_exists: nmcli -g connection.id connection show fnas-{interface} >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes
network.ipv4_dhcp: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} ipv4.method auto ipv4.addresses '' ipv4.gateway ''
network.ipv4_static: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses {ip}/{cidr} ipv4.gateway {gateway}
network.ipv6_auto: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} ipv6.method auto ipv6.addresses '' ipv6.gateway ''
network.ipv6_static: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} ipv6.method manual ipv6.addresses {ipv6}/{ipv6_prefix} ipv6.gateway {ipv6_gateway}
network.ipv6_disabled: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} ipv6.dns '' ipv6.ignore-auto-dns no ipv6.addresses '' ipv6.gateway '' ipv6.method disabled
network.dns_set: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} ipv4.ignore-auto-dns yes ipv4.dns {dns} ipv4.dns-search {dns_search} ipv6.ignore-auto-dns yes ipv6.dns {dns6}
network.dns_auto: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} ipv4.ignore-auto-dns no ipv4.dns '' ipv4.dns-search '' ipv6.ignore-auto-dns no ipv6.dns ''
network.list_physical: for d in /sys/class/net/*/device; do n=${{d%/device}}; n=${{n##*/}}; m=$(cat /sys/class/net/$n/bonding_slave/perm_hwaddr 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/class/net/$n/address); echo "$n $m $n"; done
network.connection_rename: nmcli -g connection.id connection show fnas-{old_name} >/dev/null 2>&1 && nmcli connection modify fnas-{old_name} connection.id fnas-{new_name} connection.interface-name {new_name}; true
network.bond_create: nmcli connection add type bond ifname {interface} con-name fnas-{interface} connection.autoconnect-priority 100
network.vlan_create: nmcli connection add type vlan ifname {interface} con-name fnas-{interface} connection.autoconnect-priority 100 dev {parent} id {vlan_id}
network.bridge_stp_on: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} bridge.stp yes
network.bridge_stp_off: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} bridge.stp no
network.bond_mode_lacp: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} bond.options mode=802.3ad,miimon=100
network.bond_mode_failover: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} bond.options mode=active-backup,miimon=100
bridge_port_add: nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname {port} con-name fnas-{port} connection.autoconnect-priority 100 master {interface} slave-type bridge
bond_port_add: nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname {port} con-name fnas-{port} connection.autoconnect-priority 100 master {interface} slave-type bond
network.routes_set: nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} ipv4.routes '' ipv6.routes '' && for spec in {routes}; do case $spec in *:*) f=ipv6;; *) f=ipv4;; esac; nmcli connection modify fnas-{interface} +$f.routes "${{spec%%=*}} ${{spec#*=}}" || exit 1; done
wg_apply: nmcli connection import type wireguard file /etc/freedomnas/wireguard/{interface}.conf
nmcli connection modify {interface} connection.id fnas-{interface} connection.autoconnect yes
network.wg_exists: nmcli -g connection.id connection show fnas-{interface} >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes
